phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C5 — BPM6-to-ESA F2 Concept Bridge
purpose: Test whether the recovered Eurostat/ECB BPM6 external F2 sector structure can be reconciled to the ESA/QSA F2/F2M accounting boundary strongly enough to support later F21 materialization.
promotion_rule: The concept bridge passes only if F2 coverage across the relevant BPM6 functional categories is complete at sector level: direct-investment F2 must be directly available as F2 (not substituted by composite FA__D__FL debt instruments), Other-Investment F2 is available, and Reserve-Assets F2 is identified for BNR. Only then may sector-level F2-F2M implied F21 and aggregate QSA controls be evaluated for promotion. Aggregate agreement cannot rescue missing functional-category detail or a negative sector-level implied F21.
failure_rule: If direct-investment F2 subinstrument detail is unavailable, Other-Investment plus Reserve-Assets F2 is only a known-components subtotal, not total BPM6 F2. The bridge remains blocked; the gap must not be allocated, clipped to zero, or replaced by FA__D__FL composite direct-investment debt instruments.
